messages:
elaine: Quick sync — I pushed a prototype cost panel that shows per-model token burn + cache-savings line. Seeing negative cache savings for a few tenants in the last 24h. Can someone triage? https://staging.redwood/proto/cost-panel :eyes:
noah: Saw that. Looks correlated with sticky-routing falling back to larger model during bursts. Suspect double-counting of prefetch credits or join bug. :thinking:
maria: Can you paste the exact query you're using so we can reproduce?
elaine: Sure, pasted the core aggregation here:
```sql
SELECT tenant_id, model_sku, SUM(tokens * price_per_token) - SUM(cache_credit) AS net_cost
FROM token_events
WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY tenant_id, model_sku;
```
chris: If cache_credit is emitted per-route but prefetch is applied at host-level, our join could inflate cache_credit across routes. Also router sometimes tags fallback requests with NULL model_sku which screws up grouping.
noah: We recently changed the router to tag fallback as `model='compatible-variant'` which might not map to existing skus in the cost pipeline. That would end up in a separate aggregation bucket and can look like negative savings when credits are applied elsewhere.
sam: @elaine UX reminder: for rollout views we should show per-sku and per-variant lines and a sticky-routing toggle. PMs misread a single aggregate line as the new model being cheaper when really it's routing noise.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: dashboard v0.3 deployed to staging at 2026-03-21T14:02:00Z :rocket: (staging link: https://staging.redwood/deploy/1357)
maria: Quick patch idea: when `model_sku` is NULL -> backfill from `routing_tag` during ingestion, and add an `attribution_source` column (values: hotpath, prefetch, fallback). That will let us filter prefetch-only credits in the panel.
elaine: That would help. Also we need to handle quota interplay: when quota throttles, token_count drops but prefetch still charges, making per-request unit cost spike. Need an explicit callout in the panel explanation and a prefetched-only filter.
noah: Agree. Short-term: add a `prefetch_only=true` filter and a sparkline for `unit_cost_normalized` (rolling 1h) so PMs can ignore burst artifacts.
chris: I'll open a PR: adjust router telemetry to tag fallback as `attribution_source=fallback` and add the ingestion backfill for NULL skus.
sam: UX note — default landing view should be "normalized unit cost by model" not raw net cost. Most product owners care about trend and unit economics, not ephemeral negative deltas.
elaine: Great. If everyone is OK, let's merge the telemetry + ingestion PRs and update the staging panel copy. Meet in 30m to sync before EOD merge. Thanks! :+1:
